results.title: How Facebook's Algorithmic Tweaks Affected Engagement with News URLs over Time
results.snippet: A detailed media blog post covering the International Communication Association (ICA) 2026 conference in Cape Town. The article highlights a presentation by Fabio Giglietto on how partisan alignment, journalistic quality, and Facebook's historical algorithmic tweaks impact the amplification and reach of news URLs.

results.title: SMSociety 2026 Conference Programme
results.snippet: An official event schedule and program announcement for the 2026 International Conference on Social Media & Society in Glasgow. Fabio Giglietto is featured as a speaker and panelist for the 'Meta Content Library Community Roundtable: Where to for Social Media Research?'
